records.name: House Calderan
records.description: The ruling dynasty and Crown. Its post-Rebellion authority is substantial but constrained by the political settlement and Imperial Council.

records.name: House Vaelorian
records.description: Elven Great House of the western highlands. Maintains financial dominance and trade access through diplomacy and leverage.

records.name: House Kharadorn
records.description: Dwarven Great House and empire. Seeks independence, control of the inland sea and Dragonstone, and freedom from surface interference in clan affairs.

records.name: House Edarth
records.description: Human Great House of the western heartlands. Values traditional noble rights, military and agricultural strength, and resistance to excessive royal centralization.

records.name: House Veyr
records.description: Human Great House of the northern marches. Focused on frontier security, resources for the Northern Watch, and preserving control of the north.

records.name: House Merrowen
records.description: Human Great House of the eastern coast. Protects eastern ports and shipping, commercial independence, and maritime influence.

records.name: House Denvor
records.description: Established minor human house ruling Tallowmere from Greywatch under a hereditary charter confirmed by House Kharadorn. Locally powerful but not a Great House.
records.heraldry_description: A black heron standing in shallow silver water upon a deep green field.

records.name: House Relland
records.description: Minor human noble house with a modest manor and tenant holdings along the South Road within broader House Velleran-chartered lands. House Relland bears institutional responsibility for the unlawful conduct of its retainers and subsequent cover-up in the South Road Merchant Incident.
